name: media-io
description: Media.io plugin for agent-driven video and image creation workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Edit and create videos or images in Media.io from agent-driven
interface.longDescription: Workflow skills for routing video editing and creation work to the Media.io web: importing local or attached media, creating editable projects, editing timelines, adding captions/subtitles, generating AI media assets, exporting, and verifying editor-visible changes.
defaultPrompt: Add captions or subtitles to this video
Trim and clean up this video
Add a simple overlay or transition
